author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Nomad: The Legend of Zarqa in this trailer for the upcoming action roguelike game. Experience the Arabian legend of Zarqa as you bring justice to a corrupted magical peninsula. Control your temperament, wield an enchanted bow and create satisfying combat synergies to navigate through exotic biomes in this roguelike dungeon crawler. Nomad: The Legend of Zarqa will be available on PC.
title: Nomad: The Legend of Zarqa - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Step into a food-filled world, watch as Garfield collects cheese, and check out 8 minutes of gameplay from Garfield: Escape from Monday in this latest video for the upcoming 3D platformer game. In Garfield: Escape from Monday, wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie-filled 3D platformer game. The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield: Escape from Monday! Garfield: Escape From Monday will be available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC on September 24, 2026.

#IGN #SDCC
title: Garfield: Escape from Monday - Official 8-Minute Gameplay | Comic Con 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Green Goblin Character Guide Trailer for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, a stylized action Marvel-based fighting game developed by ARC System Works. Players will learn the secrets of the trusty glider and how to disrupt opponents on the fly. Players will dominate Green Goblin’s tricky projectile game on the ground and learn to perform devastating aerial assaults to keep opponents guessing from start to finish. Take it to the skies and unleash pure madness with Green Goblin in Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, launching August 6 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Green Goblin Character Guide Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Gameplay Trailer for Mistfall Hunter, the upcoming third-person action souls-like RPG developed by Bellring Games. Mistfall Hunter is set in Weavereach, a shattered world where the gods have perished, and the Gyldenmist sweeps the realm. As a Gyldhunter, players will venture into the heart of the corruption solo or with up to two companions, defeating twisted creatures for their spoils or hunting rival Gyldhunters for their loot. Just be careful: if you die, you lose everything. Mistfall Hunter will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC on July 29, 2026.
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Launch Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Journey through different time periods in Japan in this latest Stranger Than Heaven trailer for the upcoming action-adventure game. The new Stranger Than Heaven trailer takes you to the streets of Kokura, Fukuoka in 1915; Kure, Hiroshima in 1929; and Minami, Osaka in 1943 for a look at combat gameplay. Stranger Than Heaven will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Steam on January 15, 2027.

Stranger Than Heaven is a fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.
title: Stranger Than Heaven - Official Combat Gameplay Trailer
